entities.summary: Jed Danyel Kurzel is an Australian singer-songwriter-guitarist and film composer. He is a founding member of The Mess Hall, a blues rock duo. His older brother Justin Kurzel is a film director and screenwriter. Jed Kurzel was a composers & musicians from Gawler (b. 1976, Gawler). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
